hero.headline: The Internal State that got me up Mountains and Through Valleys - Applied to Modern Life
hero.sub:
The human spirit falls into well oiled grooves when it finds itself in the natural world.  In the modern world we have to set those grooves around us because there is no environmental cue to our system.

Without knowing the ancient paradigms that live in our own minds, We can never really reach our truest potential.  

I have spent many years of nights deep in the wilderness studying my psychological limits so that you don't have to.

report.blurb: A short self-assessment for people who feel the gap but can't name it. It sorts what you're actually dealing with, and tells you which of the routes above fits — or whether it's not coaching you need right now. Free, no call required.
